byteAccounting.scope: Used portions of emitted typed arrays, excluding spare capacity, JS objects, textures, and renderer bookkeeping.

corrections: Corrected packed geometry byte accounting: Float32 positions (12), Int8 normals (3), Float32 UVs (8), Uint8 colors (4) = 27 bytes per vertex, plus Uint32 indices (12 bytes per triangle). Earlier counts incorrectly treated normals as Float32 (36 bytes per vertex). Recalculated from preserved mesh counts; no geometry or timing rerun.
notes: Timings were recorded while other tests ran; do not claim measured loading speedup or regression.
Browser/WebGL validation could not run: local Chromium socket restrictions, cloud browser local file policy and no reachable preview server.
Offline previews rasterize actual emitted triangles, without the actual material shader, textures or shadows. They are not application screenshots.
Stacked is a narrow/tall overlapping geometry stress fixture. Terraces is the properly proportioned broad horizontal deck fixture.
